items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta or go-live; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that adds no new data collection, sharing, monetization, credentials, permissions, dependencies, or cross-site behavior. Keep searchwoot.com private and leave Woot outreach unsent. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics only; current public terms do not establish public redistribution, storage, derivatives, display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, and owner gates also remain incomplete. The compliance baseline is technical only: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown; it is not certification. Exact decision: no public exposure or monetization change until rights evidence, human-counsel review, all applicable checklist dispositions, and non-legal gates are complete.

Launch-readiness tracking progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks are evidenced closed. Source-rights evidence is documented but supports access only; data-flow and consent/analytics evidence are partial; logs, vendors, incident handling, and request workflows remain open. No task is closed. Next evidence action: attach one dated read-only bundle covering repository/config data flow and retention, deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing and retention settings, log fields and access, vendor terms/DPA status, and incident/deletion/correction/request procedures.

Legal gate: do not admit scaffold builds or public launches from missing analytics, affiliate, compliance, or security evidence. For ordinary reversible work, telemetry gaps alone are not a blocker if the change preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, and data boundaries. For private or gated sites, retain the private decision and preview-only gate until the checklist is evidenced.

Revenue disposition: preserve the attribution boundary. Amazon evidence for 2026-09-21 reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission under tracking ID "other". Do not assign that commission to a site or claim revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift. Affiliate monetization remains conditional on registered tracking identifiers, destination validation, disclosure placement, and applicable platform terms.
